stories.title: KidsBank Flintshire Hub gives out 25,000 items to families in first year
stories.summary: KidsBank’s Flintshire Hub has given out more than 25,000 items to more than 300 families in its first year, and is now looking for volunteers and drivers so it can open an extra day each week. stories.title: Poor sleep most closely linked to young people’s mental health, Public Health Wales report finds
stories.summary: Trouble sleeping has the strongest link to poor mental health and low well-being among secondary school pupils in Wales, a Public Health Wales report has found. stories.title: Flintshire schools ‘rationing’ ALN support according to Cabinet Member for Education
stories.summary: Schools in Flintshire are rationing support for pupils with additional learning needs as the authority does not have the resources to cope. stories.title: Sunday Gathering artisan market returns to Mold’s Daniel Owen Square
stories.summary: Mold’s Sunday Gathering artisan market returns to Daniel Owen Square on Sunday 27 September, with 33 stalls, a dog show and free school uniforms on offer. stories.title: Greenfield Valley awarded £20,000 to grow its volunteer programme
stories.summary: Greenfield Valley has been awarded £20,000 to pay for more volunteer coordination and recruit new volunteers over the next two years. The money, from Community Lottery, will fund extended support from the valley’s Volunteer Coordinator.
